title: Software Engineer - Backend
description: Design and build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software features.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Develop and maintain robust web applications using React on the frontend and Python or Node.js on the backend. Implement responsive UI and secure REST APIs.

title: Python Developer
description: Develop backend applications, automation workflows, and microservices using modern Python frameworks like FastAPI and Django. Write unit tests and maintain high test coverage.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extract insights from complex business datasets, train predictive models, and build machine learning pipelines using Python and SQL. Present findings to stakeholders.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze large volumes of company data, create interactive Power BI dashboards, and write complex SQL queries to drive strategic business decisions.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Deploy, monitor, and scale machine learning and deep learning models in production environments. Build robust feature stores and automated model training pipelines.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create responsive, accessible, and fast web user interfaces using modern React, TypeScript, and CSS. Collaborate closely with product designers.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Build and maintain continuous integration and deployment pipelines. Manage containerized microservices on Kubernetes and maintain cloud infrastructure.

title: Java Backend Developer
description: Build high-throughput, low-latency microservices using Java and Spring Boot. Design relational database schemas and optimize query performance.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Architect and manage secure, scalable multi-cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP. Automate deployment workflows and ensure high system availability.

title: Data Engineer
description: Design and implement scalable data ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, and data warehousing solutions using Python and SQL.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Develop and maintain automated test suites for web applications and backend APIs. Integrate automated regression tests into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Graduate Software Engineer Trainee
description: Entry-level engineering role for fresh graduates. Participate in a structured technical training program covering software engineering fundamentals, algorithms, and web technologies.

title: Associate Product Manager
description: Work with cross-functional engineering, design, and business teams to define product features, track user metrics, and prioritize agile sprint backlogs.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor organizational systems for vulnerabilities, conduct threat analyses, and maintain security compliance across servers and applications.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Translate complex raw data into compelling dashboards and executive reports. Work closely with business units to understand KPIs and report metrics.

title: AI / GenAI Applications Engineer
description: Build intelligent LLM and generative AI applications using Python, prompt engineering, vector databases, and API integrations.

title: System Administrator / Cloud Ops
description: Maintain Linux production servers, configure networking and firewalls, and automate routine operational tasks with shell scripts and Python.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Develop and maintain cross-platform or native mobile applications. Integrate REST APIs and ensure smooth 60fps animations and offline caching.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Champion system reliability, uptime, and performance. Implement telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and automated failover recovery mechanisms.
